name: Open-source Galician children's fable about open source

mentions.name: Open-source Galician children's fable about open source
mentions.description: An open-source children's story told as a fable, written in Galician to teach kids about open source. Community contributors are translating it into Spanish and English, and the project seeks funding and distribution channels for printing physical copies.
mentions.problem: Finding ways to fund printing and distribute the book.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I wrote a children’s story in Galician about open source. It's told as a fable. I made it open source, and people are now helping translate it into Spanish and English.

I’m looking for ways to fund printing and distribute the book.
mentions.author: andreamr23
